Container.Name: Ghost-Hub
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted digital-footprint cleaner. Connect Gmail, Outlook / Microsoft 365 (through your own OAuth apps) and Yahoo, AOL, iCloud or any IMAP mailbox (app password), discover every service you have ever signed up for, check them against known breaches, find shadow profiles under your email, phone or username, and bulk-unsubscribe from newsletters. Everything is review-first -- nothing happens without your approval. Raw email is processed in memory and never stored, and your data never leaves your server. Requires a PostgreSQL container (set its address in DATABASE_URL). Each mail provider is optional: Gmail and Outlook need an OAuth app you create once (see the project docs), Yahoo/IMAP needs only an app password. Google and Microsoft require an HTTPS address (or localhost) for sign-in, so put Ghost-Hub behind a reverse proxy.
Early development: the app is a work in progress.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: privacy digital footprint gmail outlook yahoo imap accounts breach haveibeenpwned unsubscribe newsletters shadow profiles account discovery
Container.Requires: Requires a PostgreSQL container (e.g. postgres:17). Set DATABASE_URL to point at it.
Container.Changes: ### 0.1.0 Initial release. Admin login, database, connecting Gmail, Outlook / Microsoft 365 and Yahoo / IMAP mailboxes, inbox scanning (headers only), and a dashboard that scores each service you use for risk using Have I Been Pwned's public breach list, lets you unsubscribe from newsletters after reviewing exactly what is sent, and shows what public profiles exist under your own usernames. Review-first newsletter unsubscribe (one-click senders only) and a profile finder (public pages for your own usernames, and Gravatar for your connected addresses) are included.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: URL you reach Ghost-Hub at. Used to build the Google OAuth redirect URI (APP_URL/api/auth/google/callback).

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the web UI login.

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: 32-byte base64 key that encrypts your OAuth tokens at rest. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Losing it means reconnecting your inbox.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string for your Postgres container.

Config.Name: Google Client ID
Config.Description: Optional, for Gmail. From your own Google Cloud OAuth client (see docs/SETUP-GOOGLE-OAUTH.md in the project).

Config.Name: Google Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional, for Gmail. Secret for your Google OAuth client.

Config.Name: Microsoft Client ID
Config.Description: Optional, for Outlook / Microsoft 365. Application (client) ID of your own Entra app registration (see docs/SETUP-MICROSOFT-OAUTH.md in the project).

Config.Name: Microsoft Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional, for Outlook / Microsoft 365. Client secret value of your Entra app registration.

Config.Name: Microsoft Tenant
Config.Description: common = personal and work/school accounts. Use consumers for personal accounts only, or a tenant ID.

Config.Name: Breach Lookups
Config.Description: true downloads Have I Been Pwned's public breach list to score your services (nothing about you is sent). Set to false to make no Have I Been Pwned calls at all.

Config.Name: HIBP API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Your own Have I Been Pwned API key. Lets you press Check on the dashboard to see whether your email addresses appear in breaches (that sends the address to Have I Been Pwned). Without it, services are matched against the free public breach list by domain.
